shortDescription: Creates or removes a ClickHouse quota

options.name: apply_to
options.description: Apply this quota to the following list of users/roles dependent on O(apply_to_mode). Can include special keywords of default and current_user or the name of an actual user or role. Is an error to specify this if O(apply_to_mode=all).

options.name: apply_to_mode
options.description: When V(listed_only) (default), the quota will only apply to the users/roles specified in O(apply_to). When V(all), the quota will only apply to B(all) users/roles. When V(all_except_listed), the quota will only apply to B(all) the users/roles except those specified in O(apply_to).

options.name: client_kwargs
options.description: Any additional keyword arguments you want to pass to the Client interface when instantiating its object.

options.name: cluster
options.description: The name of the cluster where the row policy is defined. If not provided, the row policy will be managed on the local server.

options.name: keyed_by
options.description: Keys the quota by the specified key (default is to not key).

options.name: limits
options.description: The limits that this quota should enforce.

options.name: login_db
options.description: The same as the V(Client(database='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The same as the V(Client(host='...'\)) argument.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The same as the V(Client(password='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The same as the V(Client(port='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The same as the V(Client(user='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value. Be sure your the user has permissions to read the system tables listed in the RETURN section.

options.name: name
options.description: Quota name to add or remove.

options.name: state
options.description: Quota state. V(present) creates the quota if it does not exist. V(absent) deletes the quota if it exists.

options.name: success_on
options.description: List of L(server error codes,https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/blob/master/src/Common/ErrorCodes.cpp) that will be treated as success, otherwise throw errors.
